protocol.container: All conditions v6 flat blocks; layout fixed or fits-segments-v1
protocol.ordering: One full warmup/config, then shuffled condition/round jobs; encode followed by fresh-process restore. All range jobs shuffled separately.
protocol.transforms: Five preregistered methods: fixed none/global shuffle/typed, segmented none/typed; FITS subset whitelist only. Entire headers/data/padding preserved.
protocol.selection: Ordinary codec first; selected byte-shuffle candidate retained only if local payload+label cost shrinks. Full archive and dedicated sources separately allocated.
protocol.integrity: Unchanged bounded decompression, manifest/block/file SHA and external bytewise restore/range truth; deterministic archives each round.
protocol.persistence: Temporary file, flush/fsync, atomic replace and full archive digest, identical across methods.
protocol.ranges: Same original byte requests per round across every configuration/mode. 64KiB-grid cross_chunk windows may not cross a 1MiB block.
protocol.cache: Full archive pre-read; warm OS cache; no decoded-block cache; fresh process per phase/range trial.
protocol.cost: Complete archive plus whole layouts.py/numeric.py source allocated once by declared method; common Python/core/Zstd incomplete. No Blosc/RKV Rust/model/dictionary dependency.
protocol.rss: Fresh phase processes; range includes truth and metadata ledger, not production RSS
protocol.offsets: Segmented readers build unsigned-64 per-file raw-length prefix arrays; logical array bytes reported; fixed readers use arithmetic. RSS includes Python objects, truth and ledger.
protocol.acceptance: See frozen docs/LAYOUT.md: typed-segmented vs BOTH same-codec/chunk ordinary and global-shuffle; nonincreasing allocated bytes, decode/resident-p95/reopen-p95 paired median>=1 and >=4/5 faster, encoding separately disclosed.

limits: one previously seen development record, two new astronomy validation records; two unrecognized-format controls
new records share hosting/domain; not cross-domain, strict blind validation, or automatic policy trained on independent corpora
FITS whitelist only: single complete 2D primary float32/64 image; unsupported files fall back without semantic transforms
global-shuffle control width manually declared; not inferred for unknown ECG/noise files
single-host warm OS cache, five descriptive rounds; no cold/cross-machine/inference/CAS+layout/numeric Rust result
